messages:
Jin (Vendor Ops): FYI vendor 'Heliotrope' emailed asking to change tax classification from US supplier to Irish entity starting Jan 2025 and wants retroactive VAT treatment for Q1 invoices. They attached a VAT reg cert but VAT ID on cert doesn't match the billing address. Invoice list they flagged: INV-2025-001 $12,300; INV-2025-017 $8,400; INV-2025-021 $3,200. Looping in finance + tax.

Sasha (Finance): Can we do retroactive reclassification? We'll need evidence of which legal entity actually supplied the services on each invoice. If invoices were issued by the Irish legal entity we may be able to apply intra-EU B2B rules, but if the US parent issued them we can't. Ask for PDFs and VIES validation + company registry excerpt. Also need to check W-9/W-8 on file.

Olivia (Vendor): hi team — quick context: we created an Irish subsidiary, 'Heliotrope EU Ltd', and effective Jan 1 2025 we started issuing from the EU entity. The PDFs we sent show IE9876543F but I realize the billing address line still has the US parent in a couple places. Sorry for the mix. We can reissue.

Luca (Tax): We need to confirm the supplier legal entity printed on each invoice PDF. If the legal entity is Irish + VAT ID present, then reverse-charge or local VAT rules may apply. If invoices were originally billed by the US entity, we'll need credit notes and reissued invoices from the Irish company. Also ask for a signed statement of effective date and place of supply.

Acct-Bot: Ticket created: FIN-INC-2025-5692. Please attach invoice PDFs and any registry/VAT validation docs to the ticket.

Jin (Vendor Ops): Uploading PDFs to the ticket now. Quick note — INV-2025-001 PDF shows 'Heliotrope EU Ltd' with IE9876543F and an Irish bank account. INV-2025-017 & -021 seem to have been prepared by the EU team but the invoice metadata used the US parent's billing email (pay-us@heliotrope.com).

Sasha (Finance): Action items for vendor: 1) Reissue the three invoices in name of Helio­trope EU Ltd with the IE VAT ID; 2) Provide a VIES validation screenshot or link; 3) Provide company registry extract (CRO) showing incorporation date; 4) Signed statement that services were supplied by the Irish entity and effective date. We will require credit notes + reissued invoices for accounting. We can accept retroactive change once docs are provided and tax sign-off is obtained. Need this for Q1 close.

Luca (Tax): @Jin also confirm whether any US withholding was applied at payment time or if the invoices were paid net. If the US backup withholding or 10% WHT occurred, that changes the remediation. We don't gross-up payables unless contractually agreed.

Jin (Vendor Ops): Vendor confirms no US withholding applied and they do NOT want a gross-up. They prefer reissued invoices and VAT-treated reversal instead.

Sasha (Finance): I'll draft an email template for the vendor request and place a payment hold on the three invoices until we receive reissues + evidence. Target to resolve by Fri EOD.

Olivia (Vendor): Thanks — we'll get the reissued invoices, VIES printout (https://ec.europa.eu/taxation_customs/vies/), and CRO extract by EOD Thursday. Please hold payments until then.

Sasha (Finance): :thumbsup: Placing payment hold and noting required docs. @Acct-Bot can you block payments for INV-2025-001, INV-2025-017, INV-2025-021?

Acct-Bot: Payment hold placed on INV-2025-001, INV-2025-017, INV-2025-021. Hold reason: tax reclassification request — FIN-INC-2025-5692.

Luca (Tax): After docs received I'll validate VIES + CRO, confirm whether zero-VAT / reverse-charge applies, and advise on accounting entries (credit notes + reissues). If everything matches we can reclassify retroactively; if not, we keep original treatment.

Jin (Vendor Ops): Thanks all — will update ticket when vendor uploads documents.
